questions_and_answers.question: You called for Oota-buchoo. The instructor said: '只今ちょっと席を外している様ですが…何かおことづけ致しましょうか。 (Tadaima chotto seki o hazushite iru yoo desu ga... nanika okotozuke itashimashoo ka?)' What is the situation?

answers.answer: He seems to be away from his desk; shall they take a message?
He is off today; call again tomorrow
He is on a business trip
He is in a meeting

questions_and_answers.question: You called for Sasaki-san. The instructor said: '佐々木は京都へ出張でございます。来週帰る予定でございますが… (Sasaki wa Kyoto e shucchoo de gozaimasu. Raishuu kaeru yotee de gozaimasu ga...)' What is the situation?

answers.answer: Sasaki is on a business trip to Kyoto and is scheduled to return next week
Sasaki is away from his desk
Sasaki is in a meeting
Sasaki is off today

questions_and_answers.question: You called for Imai-kachoo. The instructor said: '今井は今外しております。何かおことづけがございますか。 (Imai wa ima hazushite orimasu. Nanika okotozuke ga gozaimasu ka?)' What is the situation?

answers.answer: Imai is out at the moment; is there a message?
Imai is on a business trip
Imai is off today
Imai is in a meeting

questions_and_answers.question: You called for Koyama-kachoo. The instructor said: 'あいにく小山は休みです。明日はまいりますが…おことづけがございますか。 (Ainiku Koyama wa yasumi desu. Ashita wa mairimasu ga... okotozuke ga gozaimasu ka?)' What is the situation?

answers.answer: Unfortunately Koyama is off today but will come tomorrow; is there a message?
Koyama is away from his desk
Koyama is on a business trip to Kyoto
Koyama is in a meeting

questions_and_answers.question: You called for Kaneko-buchoo. The instructor said: '申し訳ありませんが只今会議中でございます。お急ぎの用でございますか。 (Mooshiwake arimasen ga tadaima kaigichuu de gozaimasu. Oisogi no yoo de gozaimasu ka?)' What is the situation?

answers.answer: He is sorry, but Kaneko is in a meeting right now; is it urgent business?
Kaneko is off today
Kaneko is on a business trip
Kaneko is away from his desk

articles.text: Directions: The student calls a person on the phone, referring to the list below. The instructor answers, reading the script below. If the student understands, s/he answers appropriately. If not, s/he says that s/he doesn't understand Japanese well and asks for someone who speaks English.
Example: Student: Satoo-san onegai shimasu. Instructor: Ainiku desu ga, tadaima chotto seki o hazushite orimasu. Student: Sumimasen. Nihongo ga yoku wakarimasen. Eego ga wakaru hito wa imasu ka?
